title: Understanding Matrix Dimensions
text: In an OLS model, the response variable Y is a column vector with $$n$$ observations. This means it has $$n$$ rows and $$1$$ column. The design matrix X, which includes the intercept, has $$n$$ rows and $$p+1$$ columns. Make sure to consider these dimensions when evaluating the statement.

title: Matrix Multiplication in OLS
text: Recall that in OLS, the matrix multiplication X'X results in a square matrix with dimensions $$p+1$$ by $$p+1$$. This is because X has dimensions $$n$$ by $$p+1$$.
